market_hypothesis: At fixed institutional activity transitions, the previous 30-minute auction defines observable external liquidity. A boundary sweep followed within 10 minutes by a close back inside while open interest contracts represents inventory release and is traded toward the prior auction. If that branch does not occur and price remains accepted beyond the boundary after 15 minutes, the opening auction is treated as price discovery and traded in the acceptance direction.

inventory_release_reversal.condition: one prior boundary is traded through, the second completed five-minute bar closes back inside, the final confirmation candle closes in the reversal direction, and open interest declines from the pre-event observation
inventory_release_reversal.stop: event response extreme plus 0.10 prior five-minute ATR

accepted_opening_drive.condition: the reversal branch did not occur and the third completed five-minute bar remains closed beyond the prior 30-minute boundary while its candle closes in the accepted direction
accepted_opening_drive.stop: 15-minute response extreme plus 0.10 prior five-minute ATR

execution.stop_gap_policy: worse of stop or one-minute open
execution.quantity_rule: current NAV times 0.03 divided by per-unit expected stop loss including price distance, entry and stop costs, market impact and funding allowance
